Cyber-threat investigation times just dropped by 96% using automated AI workflows.

As developers and security teams look to scale operations, the latest tools are shifting from simple chatbots to highly specialized agents and offline local models.

Here are the key developments in AI and security from the past 24 hours:

🔒 Sophos reduced cyber-threat investigation times by 96% and automated 52% of its Managed Detection and Response (MDR) cases using OpenAI Daybreak, while preserving human oversight.

☁️ Google Cloud introduced Gemini Agent, a universal enterprise agent designed to answer questions, do knowledge work, create media, and write and run code from a single prompt box and API.

🔍 Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, a free service that allows open-source projects to opt-in for thorough, periodic security scans powered by their strongest models.

📝 Google released Google AI Edge Foresight, a free experimental macOS app that transcribes meetings completely offline using the on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model.

The shift toward local execution and highly specialized security agents is accelerating. Running models like EmbeddingGemma 2 directly on-device shows how practical local AI has become for sensitive data.
